plugins.contactsPermission: Kithena can suggest someone from your contacts when you are asked for an emergency contact. Only the person you choose is read.

plugins.cameraPermission: Kithena uses the camera to read the number on your ID card from a photo, so you don't have to type it, and to scan a training session's code at the door. Nothing it sees is kept.
plugins.photosPermission: Kithena uses a photo you choose for your profile.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: When your company takes clock-ins only at the office, Kithena checks once, as you clock in, whether you're there. Your location isn't kept or sent.
